title: pomaria stipularis
intro:
Pomaria stipularis, commonly known as the Mexican buckeye, is a plant species that belongs to the Fabaceae family. The Mexican buckeye is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety and insomnia due to its sedative effects. The health benefits of the plant are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of the Mexican buckeye include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
